title: The Eiffel Tower was supposed to be taken down in 1909
body: Built for the 1889 Exposition Universelle, the tower had a 20-year permit, after which it was due to pass to the City of Paris and be dismantled. Leading artists and writers had protested against it, including Guy de Maupassant, who supposedly lunched in its restaurant because it was the one place in Paris where he could not see it. It was saved by science: the tower made an ideal antenna for the new wireless telegraphy.
